analysis.C: × 第三者が持つ場合はnon-party(しかも提訴後)——装置の取り違え。
analysis.D: ○ pre-actionの4点セット:双方が見込み当事者+文書の特定+提訴されればstandard disclosureの対象+公正な処理・提訴なしの解決・費用節約に望ましい。「訴えずに済む判断材料」という制度趣旨が要件に織り込まれている。
analysis.A: × 「調査に役立つ」だけでは足りない——標準開示該当性+desirability(公正処理・提訴なし解決・費用節約)まで要る。
analysis.B: × pre-actionは提訴「前」の装置——提訴後の開示遅滞はspecific disclosureの世界。
analysis.E: × 時効の切迫は要件ではない——時効対応はprotective issue(Ch.2)の仕事。

subject: DR
stem: In a multi-track commercial claim, both parties hold very large volumes of electronic documents. The first case management conference is approaching and the parties have not yet discussed how electronic disclosure will be handled. Which of the following best describes what the parties should do?

options.A: Seek to agree the limits of the search for electronic documents — such as keyword searches, categories of document and the manner of inspection — so that the court can deal with e-disclosure at the CMC or, if necessary, at a separate hearing.
options.B: Print all electronic documents and exchange them in hard copy.
options.C: Leave electronic documents out of disclosure, as only originals need be listed.
options.D: Each party may unilaterally decide its own keywords without reference to the other, because each party alone knows its own systems and custodians, and the adequacy of its choices can be tested later through specific disclosure if necessary.
options.E: Postpone all consideration of electronic documents until trial.

expl: 正解A。e-disclosureはCPRが当事者に限定方法の合意(keywords・カテゴリ・閲覧方法)を求める領域——multiの商事事件で典型・CMCで扱う(必要なら別hearing)。(講義ノートCh.9【e-disclosure】参照)
trans: multi-trackの商事請求で、両当事者とも極めて大量の電子文書を保有している。第1回case management conferenceが近づいているが、当事者は電子開示の扱いをまだ協議していない。当事者がすべきこととして最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.D: × 一方的なkeyword設定は合意要請に反し、後で追加調査命令(specific disclosure)の火種になる。
analysis.A: ○ e-disclosureはCPRが当事者に限定方法の合意(keywords・カテゴリ・閲覧方法)を求める領域——multiの商事事件で典型・CMCで扱う(必要なら別hearing)。
analysis.B: × 全部印刷は電子開示の統制(比例性)の正反対——費用爆発の典型。
analysis.C: × 電子文書もdocumentに含まれ、開示から外せない。
analysis.E: × trialまで先送りすれば開示のタイムテーブル全体が崩れる——CMCで扱うべき事項。

subject: DR
stem: A patient issues a clinical negligence claim against an NHS trust in 2025, valued at £60,000. The trust denies both breach of duty and causation in full. The patient's solicitor asks whether the fixed recoverable costs regime will govern costs recovery if the claim succeeds. Which of the following is correct?

options.A: Yes: all claims up to £100,000 issued after 1 October 2023 fall within the FRC regime without exception, because the extension of fixed costs was designed to be comprehensive across the fast and intermediate tracks.
options.B: Yes, because the claim will be allocated to the intermediate track.
options.C: No, because clinical negligence claims are always allocated to the multi-track.
options.D: Yes, provided the trust is publicly funded.
options.E: No: clinical negligence claims are excluded from the FRC regime unless both breach of duty and causation have been admitted — and here both are denied.

expl: 正解E。FRCの適用除外リストの頻出項目——臨床過誤は「breachとcausationの双方が認められた場合」を除き除外。全部否認の本問は除外側。(講義ノートCh.10【FRC適用除外】参照)
trans: 患者が2025年にNHS trustに対し£60,000の臨床過誤請求をissueした。trustはbreach of dutyもcausationも全面否認している。患者側solicitorは、請求が認容された場合の費用回収がfixed recoverable costs制度に服するかを尋ねている。正しいものはどれか。

analysis.A: × 「例外なし」で除外リスト(住宅・中皮腫・児童等への危害・陪審・対警察)を消しにくる肢。除外の帰結は通常の費用評価(assessment)の世界に戻ること。
analysis.E: ○ FRCの適用除外リストの頻出項目——臨床過誤は「breachとcausationの双方が認められた場合」を除き除外。全部否認の本問は除外側。
analysis.B: × トラック配分はFRC適用の必要条件であって十分条件ではない——除外リストが先に効く。
analysis.C: × 「臨床過誤=常にmulti」という自動配分はない——除外の根拠はFRC規定の明文リスト。
analysis.D: × 被告の資金源はFRCの適用と無関係。

subject: DR
stem: In a multi-track claim, the court hears a half-day interim application and orders the losing party to pay the costs of the application. Both parties filed statements of costs the day before the hearing. How will the costs of the application ordinarily be quantified?

options.A: By detailed assessment after the conclusion of the whole claim, because the claim is on the multi-track.
options.B: By reference to the fixed recoverable costs tables.
options.C: By summary assessment at the conclusion of the hearing, on the basis of the statements of costs filed at least 24 hours in advance.
options.D: By the parties' own agreement only; the court has no power to quantify.
options.E: By provisional assessment on paper within three months.

expl: 正解C。summary assessmentの守備範囲はfast track trialの終結時+1日以内で終わるhearingの終結時——multiの事件でも中間申立ての費用はその場で即決が原則。24時間前のstatementが伏線。(講義ノートCh.10【summary vs detailedの選別】参照)
trans: multi-trackの請求で、裁判所が半日の中間申立てを審理し、敗れた側に申立費用の負担を命じた。両当事者はhearing前日にstatements of costsを提出していた。申立費用は通常どのように量定されるか。

analysis.A: × 「multi=常にdetailed」は本体費用の話——申立て単位の費用と混同させる罠。
analysis.E: × provisionalはdetailed内の£75,000未満の書面処理。
analysis.C: ○ summary assessmentの守備範囲はfast track trialの終結時+1日以内で終わるhearingの終結時——multiの事件でも中間申立ての費用はその場で即決が原則。24時間前のstatementが伏線。
analysis.B: × FRC表はfast・intermediateのFRC事件の装置——multiの中間申立て費用の量定方法ではない。
analysis.D: × 裁判所には量定権限がある——当事者の合意は常に可能だが「合意のみ」ではない。

subject: DR
stem: Judgment with costs was given for a claimant in a multi-track claim on 10 January. The claimant served notice of commencement of detailed assessment with its bill on 20 February. The defendant has done nothing since. It is now early April. Which of the following best describes the claimant's position?

options.A: The claimant must wait for the defendant's points of dispute indefinitely.
options.B: The defendant's 21 days for serving points of dispute have expired, so the claimant may apply for a default costs certificate for the full amount of the bill together with fixed costs and court fees.
options.C: The claimant must apply for an interim costs certificate for the undisputed part of the bill.
options.D: The claimant's notice was served out of time, because it was not served within 21 days of judgment, and a receiving party who misses that deadline loses the right to commence detailed assessment without the court's permission.
options.E: The bill must now be assessed provisionally on paper regardless of its size.

expl: 正解B。リレーの実戦:notice(判決から3ヶ月以内——2月20日は余裕でセーフ)→points of dispute21日——無応答ならdefault costs certificate(bill全額+固定費用+手数料)。(講義ノートCh.10【detailed期限リレー】参照)
trans: multi-trackの請求で、1月10日にclaimant勝訴・費用付きの判決が出た。claimantは2月20日にbillとともにdetailed assessmentのnotice of commencementを送達した。defendantはそれ以来何もしていない。現在は4月初旬である。claimantの立場として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.D: × noticeの期限は3ヶ月(21日はpoints of dispute側)——数字の入れ替え。
analysis.C: × interim certificateは「軽微な争いだけある」場合の装置。
analysis.B: ○ リレーの実戦:notice(判決から3ヶ月以内——2月20日は余裕でセーフ)→points of dispute21日——無応答ならdefault costs certificate(bill全額+固定費用+手数料)。
analysis.A: × 無期限に待つ必要はない——21日の徒過はdefault costs certificateという明確な出口につながる。
analysis.E: × provisional assessmentは£75,000未満のbillが「争われて」assessmentに進む場合の書面処理——無応答の本問はcertificateで終わる。

subject: DR
stem: A claim for £45,000 in damages, raising complex allegations against three defendants, is allocated to the multi-track. The court orders costs management. The claimant's solicitor asks when the costs budget must be filed and exchanged. Which of the following is correct?

options.A: At least 21 days before the first case management conference, because the claim is on the multi-track.
options.B: With the particulars of claim.
options.C: Costs budgets are not required, because the claim is worth less than £50,000.
options.D: With the directions questionnaire, because where the claim is valued at less than £50,000 the budget must be filed with the DQ.
options.E: Within 7 days of the first CMC.

expl: 正解D。budget期限の分岐は請求額£50,000——未満=DQと同時/超=第1回CMCの21日以上前。multiで£45,000という組合せ(価額はトラックでなく提出期限を決める)を正確に切れるか。(講義ノートCh.10【budgetの提出期限分岐】参照)
trans: 3名のdefendantに対する複雑な主張を含む£45,000の損害賠償請求がmulti-trackに配分され、裁判所がcosts managementを命じた。claimant側solicitorが、costs budgetの提出・交換の期限を尋ねている。正しいものはどれか。

analysis.C: × £50,000はbudget「不要」の線ではなく「いつ出すか」の線。
analysis.D: ○ budget期限の分岐は請求額£50,000——未満=DQと同時/超=第1回CMCの21日以上前。multiで£45,000という組合せ(価額はトラックでなく提出期限を決める)を正確に切れるか。
analysis.A: × 21日前ルートは£50,000「超」の側——価額の分岐を逆に適用している。
analysis.B: × particularsとの同時提出という期限はない——起点はDQかCMC。
analysis.E: × 「CMC後7日」という期限は存在しない——7日はCMCへのdirections案(事前)の数字。

subject: DR
stem: After judgment for a successful claimant in a multi-track claim, the court assesses costs on the standard basis. The evidence shows that the claimant refused, without any recorded reason, two proportionate offers of mediation made by the defendant at an early stage. Which of the following best describes how this affects the assessment?

options.A: The conduct of the parties, including efforts made to resolve the dispute and conduct before proceedings, is a factor the court takes into account and may lead to a reduction in the costs the claimant recovers.
options.B: It is irrelevant: only conduct during the trial itself can affect costs, because pre-action behaviour is regulated exclusively by the protocols and any complaint about it should have been raised at the allocation stage.
options.C: It automatically deprives the claimant of all costs.
options.D: It converts the assessment to the indemnity basis in the claimant's favour.
options.E: It transfers liability for costs to the claimant's solicitors.

expl: 正解A。CPR 44.4の考慮要素の筆頭=当事者の行状(提訴前を含む・解決努力の有無)——Ch.1のADR拒否がここに流れ込み、勝訴者の回収を削る。(講義ノートCh.10【CPR 44.4の行状】参照)
trans: multi-trackで勝訴したclaimantの費用をstandard basisで評価する場面で、defendantが早期に行った2回の比例的なmediationの申出を、claimantが理由の記録もなく拒否していたことが証拠上明らかになった。これが評価に与える影響として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.C: × 自動全額剥奪ではなく裁量的な減額。
analysis.D: × indemnityは制裁・Part 36の文脈——拒否した側に有利に働くはずがない。
analysis.A: ○ CPR 44.4の考慮要素の筆頭=当事者の行状(提訴前を含む・解決努力の有無)——Ch.1のADR拒否がここに流れ込み、勝訴者の回収を削る。
analysis.B: × 44.4は「提訴前を含む」行状を明文で考慮する——trial中の行状に限定する読みは条文の切り捨て。
analysis.E: × 当事者の交渉判断の責任を代理人に転嫁する装置ではない——wasted costsは代理人自身の不適切追行の場面。

subject: DR
stem: A claimant makes a valid Part 36 offer to settle its £80,000 claim for £65,000, with a relevant period expiring on 1 May. The defendant does not respond. On 20 June, shortly before trial, the defendant serves notice of acceptance. Which of the following best describes the costs consequences of acceptance?

options.A: The defendant pays the claimant's costs to 1 May; the claimant pays the defendant's costs from 1 May to 20 June, because acceptance after the relevant period always splits the costs at the date of expiry, whoever made the offer.
options.B: Each side bears its own costs, because acceptance came after the relevant period.
options.C: The defendant pays the claimant's costs, assessed on the standard basis, up to the date on which notice of acceptance was served — the position is the same whether a claimant's offer is accepted within or after the relevant period.
options.D: The defendant pays the claimant's costs on the indemnity basis together with a 10% additional sum.
options.E: The court must give judgment for £80,000, because late acceptance forfeits the discount.

expl: 正解C。帰結マップの盲点—claimantのofferの受諾はRP内外で同じ:defendantが受諾通知の日までのclaimantの費用をstandardで負担。(講義ノートCh.10【Part 36:Cのoffer遅延受諾】参照)
trans: claimantが£80,000の請求を£65,000で解決する有効なPart 36 offerをし、relevant periodは5月1日に満了した。defendantは応答しなかった。trial直前の6月20日、defendantがnotice of acceptanceを送達した。受諾の費用帰結として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.A: × split処理はdefendantのofferの遅延受諾専用——offerの主を入れ替えて誤答させる本命の罠。
analysis.D: × 10%+indemnityはtrialでbeatしたときのペナルティ(受諾で決着すれば発動しない)。
analysis.C: ○ 帰結マップの盲点—claimantのofferの受諾はRP内外で同じ:defendantが受諾通知の日までのclaimantの費用をstandardで負担。
analysis.B: × 「各自負担」はPart 36の受諾の帰結として登場しない——受諾には明文の費用ルールがある。
analysis.E: × 受諾はofferの額での解決——遅れても「満額判決」に化けることはない(そもそも判決ではなくstay+支払い)。

subject: DR
stem: In a claim for £100,000, the defendant made a Part 36 offer of £40,000 and the claimant later made a Part 36 offer to accept £70,000. Neither offer was accepted and both relevant periods expired long before trial. At trial the claimant is awarded £55,000. Which of the following best describes the Part 36 consequences?

options.A: The claimant obtains the enhanced consequences of its own offer, including an additional sum.
options.B: The defendant obtains the consequences of its offer, so the claimant pays the defendant's costs from the expiry of the defendant's relevant period.
options.C: Both offers take effect, and the enhancements cancel each other out.
options.D: The judgment is set aside and the parties are ordered to mediate.
options.E: Neither offer produces Part 36 consequences: the claimant beat the defendant's £40,000 offer but failed to match its own £70,000 offer, so costs follow the usual rules.

expl: 正解E。双方offer型の3分岐——認容£55,000はDのoffer(£40,000)超・Cのoffer(£70,000)未満の中間=どちらも効かない(通常ルール:D敗訴でC費用負担・standard)。(講義ノートCh.10【双方offerの中間勝訴】参照)
trans: £100,000の請求で、defendantが£40,000のPart 36 offerをし、claimantは後に£70,000で受け入れるPart 36 offerをした。どちらも受諾されず、両方のrelevant periodはtrialのはるか前に満了した。trialでclaimantは£55,000を認容された。Part 36の帰結として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.A: × Cのofferが効くのは自分のofferをbeatしたとき。
analysis.B: × Dのofferが効くのはbeatされなかったとき——£55,000>£40,000でDのofferは死んでいる。
analysis.E: ○ 双方offer型の3分岐——認容£55,000はDのoffer(£40,000)超・Cのoffer(£70,000)未満の中間=どちらも効かない(通常ルール:D敗訴でC費用負担・standard)。
analysis.C: × 「双方発動して相殺」という処理はない——発動条件をそれぞれ判定し、本問はどちらも不成立。
analysis.D: × 判決の取消し・調停命令はPart 36の帰結として存在しない。

subject: DR
stem: A claimant made a valid Part 36 offer of £280,000, which the defendant did not accept. At trial the claimant is awarded £300,000 in damages. The court is minded to apply the Part 36 enhancements in full. What is the maximum additional sum the court may award on the damages?

options.A: £75,000, the statutory maximum in every case.
options.B: £15,000, being 5% of the damages.
options.C: £45,000, being 15% of the damages.
options.D: £30,000, being 10% of the first £500,000 of the amount awarded.
options.E: No additional sum, because the claimant recovered more than its own offer.

expl: 正解D。加算金の料率:£500,000まで10%・超過分5%・上限£75,000——£300,000は全額が10%帯で£30,000。(講義ノートCh.10【加算金の計算】参照)
trans: claimantが£280,000の有効なPart 36 offerをし、defendantは受諾しなかった。trialでclaimantは£300,000の損害賠償を認容された。裁判所はPart 36の加重効果を全面適用する意向である。裁判所が損害賠償に付し得る加算金の最大額はいくらか。

analysis.A: × £75,000は上限であって定額ではない。
analysis.E: × 自分のofferを上回るのはequal or beatそのもの——ペナルティ発動の条件を「発動しない理由」に反転させた罠。
analysis.B: × 5%は£500,000「超過分」の料率——全額が£500,000以下の本問で登場しない。
analysis.C: × 15%という料率は制度に存在しない——10%と5%の合算という誤った発想。

subject: DR
stem: An intermediate track claim within the fixed recoverable costs regime proceeds to trial. The claimant had made a Part 36 offer which the defendant rejected; the relevant period expired at the end of stage 4 of the proceedings. At trial the claimant is awarded more than its offer. Which of the following best describes the effect on the claimant's recoverable costs?

options.A: The claimant escapes the FRC regime entirely and recovers costs on the indemnity basis, assessed by the hour, because the indemnity costs consequence of Part 36 is incompatible with fixed costs and therefore displaces them.
options.B: The claimant recovers its fixed costs with no adjustment, because FRC amounts cannot be altered.
options.C: The claimant recovers double the fixed costs for the whole proceedings.
options.D: The claimant's fixed costs are reduced by 50% for unreasonable behaviour.
options.E: The claimant recovers an amount equivalent to the fixed costs applicable to the stages from the expiry of the relevant period onwards uplifted by 35%, in place of the ordinary indemnity costs consequence.

expl: 正解E。FRC事件のPart 36はindemnityの代わりに「RP満了以降の段階のFRC+35%」——制度の接続点を正面から。(講義ノートCh.10【FRC×Part 36】参照)
trans: fixed recoverable costs制度内のintermediate track請求がtrialに進んだ。claimantはPart 36 offerをしていたがdefendantは拒否し、relevant periodは手続の第4段階の終わりに満了した。trialでclaimantはofferを上回る額を認容された。claimantの回収費用への効果として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.A: × FRCからの離脱はCPR 45.9の例外的事情の別問題。
analysis.D: × ±50%は不合理な行動(CPR 45.13)への装置——beatの帰結ではない。
analysis.E: ○ FRC事件のPart 36はindemnityの代わりに「RP満了以降の段階のFRC+35%」——制度の接続点を正面から。
analysis.B: × FRC額は不変ではない——Part 36(+35%)・不合理行動(±50%)・例外的事情(45.9)という明文の調整装置がある。
analysis.C: × 「全段階2倍」という帰結はない——加算は+35%かつRP満了以降の段階に限られる。

subject: DR
stem: A multi-track commercial claim is listed for a seven-day trial beginning in twelve weeks' time. The parties have complied with directions and filed their pre-trial checklists. Which of the following best describes the hearing the court is likely to hold at around ten weeks before trial, and its purpose?

options.A: A case management conference, to review the progress of the claim, since the rules require a further CMC whenever a trial is estimated to exceed five days so that the directions can be revisited before the parties incur trial costs.
options.B: A pre-trial review, to check compliance with directions, give directions for the preparation of the trial bundle, and set a trial timetable allocating time for each party's submissions and evidence.
options.C: A disposal hearing, to assess damages summarily.
options.D: A provisional assessment, to fix the costs of the trial in advance.
options.E: An allocation hearing, because multi-day trials require reallocation.

expl: 正解B。複数日のmulti trialの約10週前=pre-trial review——①遵守確認②bundleの指示③trial timetable(持ち時間表)の設定の3点。(講義ノートCh.11【pre-trial reviewの機能】参照)
trans: multi-trackの商事請求が12週間後開始の7日間trialに指定された。当事者はdirectionsを遵守し、pre-trial checklistsを提出済みである。trialの約10週間前に裁判所が開きそうなhearingとその目的として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.A: × CMCは配分直後の入口のhearing——trial直前のreviewと時期・機能が対になる。
analysis.C: × disposal hearingは額の査定を残すadmission処理(Ch.4)の世界。
analysis.B: ○ 複数日のmulti trialの約10週前=pre-trial review——①遵守確認②bundleの指示③trial timetable(持ち時間表)の設定の3点。
analysis.D: × provisional assessmentは費用のdetailed assessment内の書面処理——trial前に費用を先決めする装置ではない。
analysis.E: × 複数日trial=再配分という規則はない——multiのまま準備のhearing(review)を重ねるだけ。

subject: DR
stem: At trial, counsel for the claimant calls the claimant's site manager. After the witness confirms his statement, counsel asks: 'The scaffolding had been leaning dangerously for at least a week before the collapse, hadn't it?' Counsel for the defendant objects. Which of the following best describes the position?

options.A: The question is proper, because counsel may lead any witness on disputed matters.
options.B: The question is improper, because no questions at all may be asked of a witness whose statement stands as evidence-in-chief: the purpose of exchanging statements is to eliminate oral examination-in-chief entirely.
options.C: The question is proper in chief but would be improper in cross-examination.
options.D: The question is an improper leading question in examination-in-chief; questions to a party's own witness must be open and non-leading, whereas leading questions are permitted in cross-examination by the opposing party.
options.E: The propriety of the question depends on whether the witness agrees with it.

expl: 正解D。誘導の規律:主尋問=open・non-leadingのみ/cross=leading可——答えを埋め込んだ付加疑問(hadn't it?)は主尋問では不適切。(講義ノートCh.11【尋問の誘導可否】参照)
trans: trialで、claimant側counselがclaimantの現場責任者を証人として呼んだ。証人が陳述書を確認した後、counselは尋ねた——「足場は崩落の少なくとも1週間前から危険な状態で傾いていたのですよね?」。defendant側counselが異議を述べた。状況として最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.B: × WS=evidence-in-chiefでも補足の質問自体は裁判所の許可の範囲であり得る——「一切禁止」は行き過ぎ。
analysis.C: × 許否の向きを逆転させた罠——誘導が許されるのはcross-examinationの側で、主尋問では不可。
analysis.D: ○ 誘導の規律:主尋問=open・non-leadingのみ/cross=leading可——答えを埋め込んだ付加疑問(hadn't it?)は主尋問では不適切。
analysis.A: × 主尋問での誘導は争点事項について許されない——「どの証人にもlead可」はcrossの規律の誤転用。
analysis.E: × 証人が同意するかどうかは質問の適否を決めない——形式(答えの埋め込み)で判断される。

subject: DR
stem: A Master in the High Court makes a final order striking out a substantial part of a claim. The claimant, contending the Master erred in law, wishes to appeal. Which of the following correctly states the destination and time limit for seeking permission to appeal?

options.A: To a High Court Judge, applying within 21 days of the decision.
options.B: To the Court of Appeal, applying within 28 days of the decision.
options.C: To a Circuit Judge in the County Court, within 21 days.
options.D: To the Supreme Court, with no time limit.
options.E: To another Master of equivalent seniority, within 14 days.

expl: 正解A。宛先表の4行のうちMaster(High Court)→High Court Judge——「同じHigh Courtの中で判事のレベルが上がる」型。期限は原審がHigh Courtなので21日。(講義ノートCh.11【上訴の宛先(Master型)】参照)
trans: High CourtのMasterが、請求の相当部分をstrike outする終局的命令をした。claimantはMasterが法の適用を誤ったと主張して上訴したい。上訴許可を求める宛先と期限として正しいものはどれか。

analysis.B: × CAへ行くのはHigh Court Judgeの決定/28日はCAの決定への期限——2つの取り違えを同時に仕込んだ肢。
analysis.A: ○ 宛先表の4行のうちMaster(High Court)→High Court Judge——「同じHigh Courtの中で判事のレベルが上がる」型。期限は原審がHigh Courtなので21日。
analysis.C: × County CourtのCircuit Judgeは「County DJの決定」の上訴先——High CourtのMasterの決定とは無関係の行。
analysis.D: × Supreme Courtは最上級審への例外的な飛越えの世界——Masterの決定の通常の宛先ではなく「無期限」も誤り。
analysis.E: × 同格のMasterへの上訴という制度はない——宛先は常に一段上の裁判官レベル。

subject: DR
stem: A judgment creditor applies for a charging order over the debtor's freehold commercial unit. A court officer makes an interim charging order without a hearing. The order and supporting documents are served on the debtor within 21 days. The debtor does nothing at all in response. Which of the following best describes what happens next?

options.A: The interim order lapses automatically after 14 days of inaction.
options.B: A judge must hold a hearing before any final order can be made, whether or not the debtor objects, because an order that secures a judgment debt against a person's property is too serious to be made on paper alone.
options.C: If the debtor files no response within 14 days of service, the interim order will become final without a hearing, securing the judgment debt against the property.
options.D: The creditor must immediately apply for an order for sale, which is granted automatically.
options.E: The charging order is unavailable because the debtor did not consent.

expl: 正解C。3段階の急所:interim(hearingなし・court officer)→21日以内に送達→debtorが14日で無応答なら自動的にfinal。異議があるときだけ28日の理由書→判事のhearingへ。(講義ノートCh.11【charging orderの3段階】参照)
trans: 判決債権者が、債務者のfreehold商業物件へのcharging orderを申し立てた。court officerがhearingなしでinterim charging orderを発した。命令と添付書類は21日以内に債務者へ送達された。債務者は一切応答しない。次に起こることとして最も適切なものはどれか。

analysis.D: × order for saleはさらに別の申立てで自動ではない——chargingは「登記して待つ」執行。
analysis.E: × 執行に債務者の同意は不要——charging orderは判決債務を担保化する強制手続そのもの。
analysis.C: ○ 3段階の急所:interim(hearingなし・court officer)→21日以内に送達→debtorが14日で無応答なら自動的にfinal。異議があるときだけ28日の理由書→判事のhearingへ。
analysis.A: × interim orderは放置で失効しない——逆で、無応答なら14日でfinalに固まる。
analysis.B: × 異議がなければhearingなしでfinalになる——「常にhearing」はcourt officer処理の設計を否定している。
